I encoded the spot-check masses using the stated ~6.4e-13 order for lack of individual numeric text values (frequencies converted to mass via m=4.136e-15*f). The broadband pilot curve (Fig 9/12) reaches ~1e-11 to 1e-12 over 50-300 MHz but is only shown graphically.
